manifest.title: PTS Discord Bot
manifest.author: BrutalBirdie
manifest.tagline: Discord bot with a web UI to schedule voice and message tasks

set-discord-token.message: Set DISCORD_TOKEN in /app/data/env.sh and switch on the Server Members intent of the bot in the Discord Developer Portal. Restart the app after editing env.sh.

set-admins.message: Set admins: add Cloudron usernames to BOT_ADMINS or Cloudron groups to BOT_ADMIN_GROUP in /app/data/env.sh.

manifest.description:
## About

A Discord bot with a web UI to control it. Sign in with your Cloudron account.

* Tasks on a schedule (daily, weekly, once or cron, in any timezone) or started by hand
* Task steps: join a voice channel or the channel a member is in, play a sound, send a message, send a direct message, wait, leave
* Saved messages with text, up to 10 embeds, images and files, with a preview of how Discord shows them
* Media library for sounds, images, videos and files. Sounds can be played in a voice channel right away
* Servers and channels the bot is in, with the permissions it is missing
* Run history per task. Tasks pause themselves on errors retrying cannot fix, and failures can be posted to a channel
* Admins change settings and see an audit log of all changes
manifest.changelog:
* Web UI with Cloudron login, n8n is no longer needed
* Tasks on a schedule or started by hand: join voice, play sounds, send messages and direct messages, wait, leave
* Saved messages with embeds and files, media library, run history and audit log
* Sound files from /app/data/sounds move into the media library
* The HTTP API (POST /play) is removed
manifest.postInstallMessage:
The bot needs a Discord bot token before it connects.

1. Create an application in the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications). Under **Bot**, click **Reset Token** and copy the token. On the same page, switch on **Server Members Intent**.
2. Set `DISCORD_TOKEN` in `/app/data/env.sh`. Add your Cloudron username to `BOT_ADMINS` there, or a group to `BOT_ADMIN_GROUP`. Restart the app.
3. Open the app, go to **Servers** and add the bot to your Discord server with the invite link.
4. Upload sounds under **Media** and create a task under **Tasks**.
